name: Brewery
description: Towering copper vats rise toward the ceiling, connected by polished pipes and curious translucent tubing.
Ancient presses, mills, and fermentation casks remain remarkably intact,
while small maintenance machines continue to wipe dust from equipment unused for generations.

outcomes.text: The brewery equipment itself seems unused for years if not generations.  However one of the casks has had it's lid pried open, to reveal beer remarkably well perserved.  Half the barrel has been drained.  A nearby bowl still smells of the same beer.
